dimensions.title: Video Pacing
dimensions.publishExpectation: Segments are short enough to review, chaptered, and avoid long passive stretches without a learner action.

dimensions.title: Worked Examples
dimensions.publishExpectation: The lecture includes original concrete examples that connect the objective to observable learner work.

dimensions.title: Active Recall
dimensions.publishExpectation: The learner is asked to predict, name, retrieve, or decide before the answer is revealed.

dimensions.title: Misconception Checks
dimensions.publishExpectation: The lecture calls out likely misconceptions and uses diagnostic questions or contrasts.

dimensions.title: Accessibility
dimensions.publishExpectation: Captions, transcript, chapters, slide alt text, and non-visual narration are present.

dimensions.title: Assessment Handoff
dimensions.publishExpectation: The lecture ends with a practice or assessment artifact that can create evidence without counting watch completion as mastery.

dimensions.title: Learning Environment
dimensions.publishExpectation: The lecture prompts a low-distraction setup, pen-and-paper note taking, pausing for retrieval, and rewriting notes after the lecture.

dimensions.title: Board Clarity
dimensions.publishExpectation: Board work is legible, narrated, available as a close-up, and useful without relying on video alone.

dimensions.title: Instructor Realism
dimensions.publishExpectation: The generated instructor has consistent identity, natural gaze and gestures, visible board-aware teaching moves, and no real-person cloning or undisclosed synthetic presence.

dimensions.title: Motion and Lip-Sync QA
dimensions.publishExpectation: Rendered instructor video passes visual QA for lip-sync timing, gaze direction, head and hand motion naturalness, and board-writing gesture synchronization before publish promotion.

dimensions.title: Adaptive Continuity
dimensions.publishExpectation: The lecture explains how checkpoint and assessment evidence will shape the next lecture while still covering the required material.

fixtureScores.notes: Deterministic fixture meets the publishable baseline for each video-specific teaching dimension.
